messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Regarding p-value and q-value in DMRs
parts:
P-values are obtained from the statistical tests and q-values are "corrected" versions of P-values for multiple-testing. There are references in the vignette for more theoretical description and when slim=FALSE we just use p.adjust() function. This is in the documentation I believe. 

Best,
Altuna
